extraction.Name: Benjamin Drapeau
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The mortgage I had placed on the land resulted in my selling the land as it was time to pay it.
extraction.NOTES: Patent was sent in the mail in 1918 at Camp Funston, Kansas. Did not ask for the patent. Got $2500 by mortgage and $6000 net at the time of sale. Sale was a cash deal; no debts settled with purchaser. Not married. Was satisfied with the sale. Document notarized April 30, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
